verdict.rationale: Barge-in handling is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents interruption handling. There is no mention of stopping speech, updating context, or recovering the turn when a caller cuts in. The transcription-mode endpointing settings and the generic 'call handling' claim are adjacent latency and turn-detection controls, not barge-in support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on the agent to handle interruptions (barge-in) gracefully — stopping speech, updating context, and recovering the turn
